Based on our discussions and the data we've reviewed, I believe we should prioritize education, healthcare, and economic development, while also investing in green spaces and infrastructure. A possible allocation could be around 26-27% to education, 24-25% to healthcare, 18% to green spaces, 16% to infrastructure, and 16% to economic development. This balanced approach aims to support the well-being and prosperity of our community, while also ensuring that we're investing in areas that will have a lasting impact. Ultimately, the goal is to make a positive difference in the lives of our residents and create a thriving community for everyone.
